issues.message: 417 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.

notes.detail: Workbench row, chests, crafting table, log piles, but the catapult is only a flat 1-high log frame with trapdoor wheels.
notes.artefacts: Two floating slabs and a gable hole.
notes.purpose: Reads as a barn/house with an open front; nothing visible says siege engines. Catapult is almost invisible: hidden under the low roof in every iso, and from the front only a pale block mass shows behind the dark beam at (3..7,4,1).
notes.depth: Posts, open bays, plinth corners and lean-to give good shadows.
notes.roof: Steep with overhang and slab ridge, but the front gable is open, the back gable has a hole and the lean-to roof is flat.
notes.materials: Four woods (oak, spruce, dark oak, stripped oak) with little stone; very brown overall.
notes.shape: Main shed with a side lean-to and log piles: not a box.
notes.scale: The L1 catapult is a 1-high flat frame that reads as a floor pattern, not an engine.

visual.summary: Open-bay timber shed with a deck, a half-built catapult base, workbench row and a tool lean-to; the catapult itself does not show.
problems: Catapult is almost invisible: hidden under the low roof in every iso, and from the front only a pale block mass shows behind the dark beam at (3..7,4,1). Make it visible: put the catapult under the open front gable (z1..4) and raise or remove the front beam, or let a part of it stand out on a front apron.
Floating blocks: oak slabs at (6,2,2) and (7,2,2) have nothing under them (y1 is air there); add the bench legs or remove them.
Back gable has a 1-block hole at (5,5,11) (row 'VTT.TTW'); fill it or make it a clear vent (trapdoor/fence).
Front gable is completely open (y5..6 at z1); for a shed that is acceptable, but give it barge boards or a partial infill so it looks finished.
Lean-to roof (spruce slabs at y3, x9..12 z2..10) is dead flat and reads as a deck; slope it with stairs down to x12.
No life at all: add a lantern at the front, hay or plants at the base.
Reachability: fine; unreached places are roof slopes, the flat lean-to roof and catapult/bench tops, no room or floor is cut off.

issues.message: 423 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.roof: Main roof is one plank tone with only a darker eave row; overhang warning partly real at the front gable. Steep, catslide lean-to now sloped.
notes.materials: Still mostly brown (roof, frame, catapult, crates); stone plinths and cobble yard help.
notes.detail: Catapult frame in the yard, sawhorses, log piles; few small blocks on the side walls.

visual.summary: Open timber shed with stone plinths and a catslide tool store; the catapult base (rails, wheels, A-frame) now stands in a cobble yard in front of the open gable.
problems: Last round's fixes check out: catapult visible in the front yard, no floating sawhorse slabs, back gable closed, front gable infilled, lean-to sloped.
Roof and timber are one brown tone: give the main roof a dark oak ridge/verge or a contrasting eave row along the long sides.
Long sides have little small detail: add a lantern or tool rack on the east and west walls.
Reachability: fine; only roof slopes, prop and furniture tops are unreached, no room or floor is cut off.
